sourcePatches.verification: Actual original native reader fails to recover six original records; corrected original-asset decode and exact forty-byte real-file save/partial-tail checks pass. Actual original twenty-letter name entry traps with stack protection/patterned locals; corrected twenty-make-event and empty-name dispatch passes.

sourcePatches.reason: Import the existing graphics interface owning the decoder declaration so its definition and renderer callers share the same full-width pointer contract.
sourcePatches.verification: The same actual native64 renderer regression passes with the definition and callers checked against the shared owning declaration.

sourcePatches.reason: Issue the original set-mode BIOS request once, checking its result instead of resubmitting the returned AX004F as a new INT10 request.
sourcePatches.verification: Actual original vg_init fixture asserts that BIOS output must not become a second request, original RED then corrected GREEN; physical D0000000 constant is unchanged.

sourcePatches.reason: Declare the project XPM decoder with its actual char-pointer return type in the existing graphics interface.
sourcePatches.verification: Original actual menu and ship renderers dereference an implicitly truncated >32-bit decoder result and SIGSEGV; with the owning declaration both render their expected pixel on native64.
